faq.heroSub: Browse our knowledge base or search for a topic below.
faq.g1a: SKINSELL is a platform for instantly selling your CS2 skins for real money. Unlike marketplaces where you wait for buyers, we buy your skins directly at competitive rates. Choose from multiple payout methods — card, crypto, bank transfer, or site balance — and get paid within minutes.
faq.g2a: Absolutely. SKINSELL uses Steam's official OpenID for authentication — we never see or store your password. All trades happen through Steam's secure trading system. Every transaction is logged, tracked in real time, and protected by SSL encryption. Thousands of users trust us daily.
faq.g3q: How do I create an account?
faq.g3a: You don't need to register separately. Simply click "Sign In" in the top-right corner and log in through Steam's official page. Your SKINSELL account is created automatically. We never access your Steam credentials.
faq.g4q: How does the selling process work?
faq.g4a: It's simple: 1) Sign in via Steam. 2) Go to the Sell page and select the skins you want to sell. 3) Enter your Trade URL and choose a payout method. 4) Confirm and accept our trade offer in Steam. 5) Receive your payment instantly or after the trade hold ends.
faq.g5a: Our pricing engine uses real-time market data from multiple sources. You typically receive up to 95% of market value. Prices update automatically and are displayed in your preferred currency (USD, EUR, RUB, etc.).
faq.g6a: Our bots are verified Steam accounts that send you trade offers. Always check that the trade offer comes from an account on our official bot list (available in your dashboard). Never accept offers from unverified accounts — contact support if something looks suspicious.
faq.p1a: We support multiple payout methods: Site Balance (0% fee), Cryptocurrency — Bitcoin & USDT (lowest fees), Bank Transfer via SEPA/SWIFT, and Debit/Credit Cards (Visa, Mastercard). Available methods may vary depending on your region.
faq.p2a: Balance payouts are instant. Crypto payouts typically arrive within 10–30 minutes. Card payouts take 1–3 business days. Bank transfers take 2–5 business days. If items have a CS2 trade hold, payout is processed after the hold period ends.
faq.p3a: Select Card as your payout method and enter your Visa or Mastercard details. After the trade is completed, funds are sent directly to your card. Processing time depends on your bank — usually 1–3 business days.
faq.p4a: Choose Bitcoin or USDT as your payout method and paste your wallet address. After we receive your skins, the payment is sent to your wallet. Crypto transactions are fast — typically confirmed within 10–30 minutes.
faq.p5q: How do I add funds to my balance?
faq.p5a: Your SKINSELL balance is funded by selling skins with "Balance" selected as the payout method. This option has 0% commission, making it the most profitable choice. Balance funds can later be cashed out via any supported method.
faq.p6q: How do I withdraw my balance?
faq.p6a: Go to your Balance page, click "Cash Out", select a withdrawal method (card, crypto, or bank), enter the amount and your payment details. Withdrawals are reviewed and processed promptly by our team.
faq.p7a: Fees depend on the payout method: Balance — 0%, Crypto — from 1%, Bank Transfer — from 2%, Card — from 3%. The exact commission is always displayed on the Sell page before you confirm your order, so there are no surprises.
faq.s1q: How do I protect my account?
faq.s1a: Enable Steam Guard Mobile Authenticator for maximum security. Keep your Trade URL private and regenerate it if you suspect it's been compromised. SKINSELL will never ask for your Steam password, API key, or authentication codes.
faq.s2q: How do I recognize scam attempts?
faq.s2a: Scammers may impersonate SKINSELL staff or bots. Remember: we will never ask you to send items without a proper Steam trade offer, never ask for your password or API key, and never contact you first via DM. Always verify trade offers come from our official bots.
faq.t1q: What is a Trade URL and where do I find it?
faq.t1a: A Trade URL is a unique Steam link that lets us send you trade offers. To find yours: open Steam → click your profile name → Settings → Privacy → scroll to "Trade Offers" → click "Create new URL" or copy the existing one. Paste it on the Sell page.
faq.t2q: Why can't I see my skins in the inventory?
faq.t2a: Your Steam inventory must be set to Public. Go to Steam → Profile → Edit Profile → Privacy Settings → set "My inventory" to "Public". Also ensure the items aren't on trade hold, listed on another marketplace, or in a different game tab.
faq.t3q: I sold my skins but haven't received payment yet?
faq.t3a: If your skins left your inventory, the trade was successful. Check your order status on the Orders page. Some payout methods take time to process (cards: 1–3 days, bank: 2–5 days). If payment is delayed beyond the expected time, contact support with your Order ID.
faq.t4q: Can I cancel a trade after accepting?
faq.t4a: During the CS2 trade hold period (up to 7 days), you can cancel from your Steam inventory. Once the hold ends and items are delivered, the trade is final and cannot be reversed. Contact our support team if you need help.
faq.c1a: CS2 skins are cosmetic weapon finishes in Counter-Strike 2. Each skin has a rarity tier (Consumer to Covert) and wear condition (Factory New, Minimal Wear, Field-Tested, Well-Worn, Battle-Scarred). Rare skins with good float values can be worth hundreds or even thousands of dollars.
faq.c2q: How do I sell my CS2 skins on SKINSELL?
faq.c2a: Sign in with your Steam account, navigate to the Sell page, and select CS2 from the game tabs. Pick the skins you want to sell, paste your Trade URL, choose how you want to be paid, and confirm. Accept our bot's trade offer in Steam — done!
faq.c3q: What is the CS2 trade hold and how does it affect payouts?
faq.c3a: Valve enforces a mandatory trade hold on CS2 items — after you accept a trade, items may be held for up to 7 days before delivery. Your payout is processed once the hold ends and we receive the items. Enable Steam Guard Mobile Authenticator to minimize hold times.
faq.c4q: Which CS2 skins does SKINSELL accept?
faq.c4a: We accept most tradable CS2 skins including weapons, knives, gloves, stickers, and agents. Items must be tradable (not on trade hold) and not listed on other marketplaces. Some extremely low-value items (under $0.03) may not be available for instant sale.
